items.title: Liverpool look for new sporting director after Richard Hughes formally leaves
items.summary: Hughes in line for similar role at Saudi club Al-Hilal FSG president Mike Gordon leads search for successor Liverpool are searching for a fourth sporting director in four years after confirming that Richard Hughes has stepped down from the role. Hughes’s departure has been long expected, with the 47-year-old in line to take up a similar position with the Saudi Pro League club Al-Hilal. He informed Liverpool of his intentions to leave early this year, after the departure of his friend Michael Edwards as chief executive of football for Fenway Sports Group, the club’s owner. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘Reverse bucket list’: Arteta channels Wenger in defence of Arsenal window
items.summary: The champions’ manager echoed his illustrious predecessor and urged fans unhappy at the lack of a deadline-day arrival to see the bigger picture For many people connected to Arsenal, it has been a time to remember the old line from Arsène Wenger. “We live in a society of ‘news’,” the club’s former manager once said, and by that he meant new things – the shinier the better. Nowhere is the obsession more obvious than in the transfer market, when a club simply has to add new faces. These days, it feels as though some fans prefer them to be signed as late as possible in the summer window to ensure a positive narrative after the deadline; to maximise the potential to generate momentum. Recency bias is powerful. Continue reading...

items.title: Pas encore "has-been" : Luka Modric continue avec la Croatie !
items.summary: Luka Modric est éternel. Alors qu'on pensait que la Coupe du Monde 2026 signerait la fin de son histoire avec l'équipe nationale croate, le milieu de terrain de l'AC Milan a finalement décidé de continuer. Il sera présent dans le groupe repris par Slaven Bilic pour la prochaine campagne de Ligue des Nations.

items.title: Verrijzenis bij KAA Gent: belangrijke pion viert zijn terugkeer na 252 dagen aan de kant

items.title: Voilà pourquoi Standard - Antwerp pourrait "partir dans tous les sens" ce samedi soir

Vincent Euvrard s'attend à une rencontre qui pourrait partir "dans tous les sens", avec des Anversois qui attaquent beaucoup mais qui concèdent aussi des occasions, tandis qu'Ibe Hautekiet se réjouit d'affronter Michael Frey, un attaquant physique qui lui convient mieux qu'un petit format plus rapide, selon ses propres dires.

items.title: Totale ommekeer: stadsbestuur Luik neemt beslissing over Antwerp-fans vanavond in Sclessin
